# Let's solve this systematically
# x[0] = count of 0s in sequence
# x[1] = count of 1s in sequence
# x[2] = count of 2s in sequence
# x[3] = count of 3s in sequence

from itertools import product

for seq in product(range(5), repeat=4):
    x = list(seq)
    # Check if x[i] == count of i in x, for all i
    if all(x[i] == x.count(i) for i in range(4)):
        print(f"Solution found: {x}")
